entries.what_happened: Review Queue could not access credential records in the login Keychain.
entries.why_it_matters: Credential-backed GitHub and Copilot actions cannot continue without the protected capability record.
entries.data_safety: No plaintext credential fallback was used, and review data remains unchanged.
entries.next_action: Open Keychain Access, select and unlock the login keychain, then choose Retry connection.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Close Application settings to return to the unchanged queue.

entries.what_happened: The GitHub Device Flow expired, was denied, or no longer has a pending request.
entries.why_it_matters: The old public code cannot authorize a connection and must never be reused.
entries.data_safety: The pending record was removed and no credential or review data changed.
entries.next_action: Choose Start fresh flow to request a new public code.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Close Application settings to leave the capability disconnected.

entries.what_happened: GitHub approved the flow for an account other than the expected account shown by Review Queue.
entries.why_it_matters: Using the wrong identity could read from or publish to a repository as an unintended account.
entries.data_safety: The returned credential was discarded and no GitHub request or review-data change followed.
entries.next_action: Disconnect this capability, then reconnect it with the intended GitHub account.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Close Application settings to keep the capability disconnected.

entries.what_happened: The selected Copilot authentication source is unavailable.
entries.why_it_matters: Review Queue cannot start the explicitly requested /ask session without validating that selected source.
entries.data_safety: No prompt was sent, no credential was changed, and the local draft remains saved.
entries.next_action: Open Application settings, connect the displayed Copilot source, then explicitly retry the prompt.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Close chat to return to the review without sending the draft.

entries.what_happened: The selected Copilot model or saved model option is not available.
entries.why_it_matters: Sending with a silently substituted model would change the user's explicit provider choice.
entries.data_safety: No prompt was sent and the conversation draft and transcript remain saved.
entries.next_action: Refresh Copilot capabilities and select one supported model.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Close chat to keep the draft without starting a provider request.

entries.what_happened: The explicitly requested remote operation could not reach its provider.
entries.why_it_matters: Review Queue cannot safely infer whether a remote read or prompt attempt can proceed.
entries.data_safety: Local drafts remain saved and no automatic retry or prompt replay will occur.
entries.next_action: Check network access, then explicitly retry the same operation once.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Dismiss the error to continue reviewing cached local data.

entries.what_happened: The pull request head or open state no longer matches this immutable review round.
entries.why_it_matters: Publishing or reviewing mutable upstream content would detach comments from the exact code that was inspected.
entries.data_safety: The old round and formal drafts remain saved as outdated, and no GitHub write occurred.
entries.next_action: Choose Refresh into new round and review the current pull-request head.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Return to Queue Home to keep viewing the old round as outdated.

entries.what_happened: The immutable snapshot needed for this review is unavailable or no longer matches its source item.
entries.why_it_matters: Falling back to a mutable worktree would show code other than the recorded review round.
entries.data_safety: No mutable fallback was used, no source file changed, and cached review metadata remains available.
entries.next_action: Choose Reproduce from source to restore the recorded snapshot.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Return to Queue Home without opening a different source state.

entries.what_happened: The originating agent route is busy, disconnected, or no longer reachable.
entries.why_it_matters: Review Queue cannot deliver formal feedback exactly once to an unavailable session.
entries.data_safety: Formal drafts remain saved and no delivery, terminal typing, or keystroke injection occurred.
entries.next_action: Choose Copy feedback prompt and submit it manually to the intended agent.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Close the delivery drawer to keep the formal drafts queued.

entries.what_happened: Review Queue could not establish or retain the configured connected-machine tunnel.
entries.why_it_matters: The remote queue and immutable snapshots cannot be refreshed through an unverified transport.
entries.data_safety: Cached rounds remain available and no remote data or credential changed.
entries.next_action: Inspect the configured SSH target and daemon socket, then choose Reconnect.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Disconnect the machine to continue with cached local rounds only.

entries.what_happened: GitHub rejected or could not safely confirm the explicit publish request.
entries.why_it_matters: A blind retry could duplicate feedback or publish against a changed pull-request head.
entries.data_safety: Formal drafts remain saved and Review Queue will not retry the GitHub write automatically.
entries.next_action: Refresh the pull-request head and reconnect PR publish before preparing one new publish attempt.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Close the publish dialog to keep all formal drafts local.

entries.what_happened: The workspace, selected repositories, or Git state changed after capture preflight.
entries.why_it_matters: Continuing would bind the review round to source state other than the exact state the user approved.
entries.data_safety: No torn review round was saved and Review Queue made no additional source-file change.
entries.next_action: Wait for the workspace to become stable, then run capture preflight again.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Cancel submission to keep the workspace and queue unchanged.

entries.what_happened: Review Queue could not create or safely finalize a submission snapshot commit.
entries.why_it_matters: A review round cannot be trusted unless every repository snapshot and its queue record are committed atomically.
entries.data_safety: Source files and original staging indexes were preserved; any owned partial snapshot was rolled back when safe.
entries.next_action: Fix the reported Git or hook failure, then submit the same workspace again.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Cancel submission to leave the existing queue and workspace state in place.

entries.what_happened: Publish review is unavailable because no Approve or Request changes decision is recorded.
entries.why_it_matters: GitHub review publishing requires an explicit formal decision and must never infer one from comments or UI state.
entries.data_safety: The publish control remains disabled, formal drafts stay local, and no GitHub write can occur.
entries.next_action: Choose either Approve or Request changes for this round.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Return to the review without recording a decision or publishing.

entries.what_happened: Review Queue could not refresh the pull request's upstream discussion.
entries.why_it_matters: The reviewer cannot claim that its imported GitHub comments or resolution state are current.
entries.data_safety: Existing cached comments and local formal drafts remain saved, and no GitHub write occurred.
entries.next_action: Check PR read access, then choose Refresh comments once.
entries.diagnostics_route: Application settings → Privacy and diagnostics → Open redacted diagnostics.
entries.cancel_route: Dismiss the refresh error to continue with clearly cached discussion.

entries.what_happened: The CLI could not reach the running Review Queue desktop data plane.
entries.why_it_matters: The token-free CLI cannot read or enqueue review state without the owner-only desktop socket.
entries.data_safety: The CLI did not obtain credentials or mutate source files, commits, or review data.
entries.next_action: Launch the Review Queue desktop app, then rerun the same CLI command.
entries.diagnostics_route: Run review-queue diagnose after the desktop app is reachable.
entries.cancel_route: Exit the CLI command to leave local source and queue state unchanged.

entries.what_happened: The CLI request requires a desktop-owned capability that is not connected.
entries.why_it_matters: The token-free CLI cannot accept a credential or silently expand its authority.
entries.data_safety: No provider request, credential change, or queue mutation occurred.
entries.next_action: Open Application settings and connect the capability named by the error.
entries.diagnostics_route: Run review-queue diagnose to confirm the token-free data plane remains reachable.
entries.cancel_route: Exit the CLI command to keep the capability disconnected.

entries.what_happened: The connected-machine name, SSH target, socket path, or endpoint combination is invalid.
entries.why_it_matters: Saving ambiguous transport data could connect to the wrong daemon or place credential material in token-free configuration.
entries.data_safety: No machine configuration was saved, no tunnel started, and no credential or review data changed.
entries.next_action: Correct the named machine field in the error, then add the machine again.
entries.diagnostics_route: Run review-queue diagnose to verify the local token-free data plane.
entries.cancel_route: Cancel machine setup to keep the current source list unchanged.
